steps.what: Define the actual astronomical research question, comparison, uncertainty treatment and significance criteria before analysing the data.
inputs: Actual research question and scientific context
outputs: Actual analysis specification and limitations

steps.what: Retrieve and inspect the actual research files in {DATA_PLATFORM}, checking calibration provenance, units, selection effects and missing observations against the analysis question.
outputs: Actual selected dataset and known data-quality limitations

steps.what: Write and repair the task-specific analysis notebook code in {DATA_PLATFORM}, implementing the astronomer's selected models, uncertainty calculations and diagnostic tests.
inputs: Actual dataset schema and limitations from s2
outputs: Inspected analysis code and explicit diagnostics

loop.purpose: Draft bounded implementation code for the astronomer's specified analysis
loop.input: Actual permitted schema, explicit model specification and reference numerical checks from s1-s2
loop.output: Draft notebook code with diagnostics and no inferred scientific choices
loop.check: Astronomer inspects code in s3 and checks actual outputs, diagnostics and scientific implications in s4 and s6
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; failed checks or unsupported library behaviour return to manual implementation
loop.why_not_simpler: Reuse existing scientific routines first; task-specific joins, diagnostic code and uncertainty plumbing may still require custom implementation.

steps.what: Run the actual inspected analysis code with existing scientific software in {DATA_PLATFORM} and examine the numerical diagnostics, rerunning or repairing actual failures.
outputs: Actual computed results and diagnostics or unresolved failure

steps.what: Assemble the actual computed outputs into the existing diagnostic plot and result-table layout in {DATA_PLATFORM}, using a reusable native notebook plotting/export cell.
inputs: Actual computed outputs and diagnostics from s4
Actual required plot/table specification from s1
outputs: Draft diagnostic plots and numerical result tables

steps.what: Analyse the actual research data results to determine their scientific significance, checking diagnostics, competing explanations and uncertainties rather than accepting a nominal significance value alone.
outputs: Actual scientific interpretation and limits

steps.what: Write the actual analysis conclusions, provenance and unresolved issues in the research notebook {DATA_PLATFORM} so the actual calculation can be reproduced.
inputs: Actual notebook, dataset and diagnostic versions from s2-s5
outputs: Actual completed analysis notebook and interpretation

steps.what: Save the actual analysis notebook in the same {DATA_PLATFORM} working area.
outputs: Saved actual notebook

tasks.design: Keep scientific specification and inference with the astronomer. Reuse existing scientific routines before bounded code drafting, and use a reusable plot/export cell only for actual manual output assembly. Existing numerical calculation runtime earns no new saving. Actual data retrieval, code repair, diagnostic inspection and interpretation remain explicit; no autonomous scientific conclusion or publication is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Task-specific notebook plumbing and repeated output assembly can consume time even when scientific routines already exist.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded code drafting and reusable notebook output cells can reduce those implementation actions without choosing the science.
tasks.still_hard: Selection bias, calibration error and model misspecification can survive syntactically correct code.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what the evidence means and which alternative explanations remain credible.

ambition.what: Consider an additional scientifically justified diagnostic after validating the current analysis; extra demand is not included as a saving.

tasks.altitude: Specify reproducible tests and uncertainty standards for analysis code.

evidence.claim: Bounded code drafting and native notebook plot templates can assist implementation without establishing astronomical significance.

assumptions: Actual observation files are produced by the existing observing/calibration workflow; this proposal does not remove that work or create new observations.
Estimated shares cover active analyst labour, not existing automatic processing runtime.
The retained 65% of s3 includes inspection, numerical test work and failed-draft manual repair; s4 retains running and output diagnostics.
The output cell replaces actual manual assembly only where its axes, units and metadata are compatible.
unknowns: Actual code reuse, dataset schema and proportion of genuinely manual output assembly
research_questions: Replay a completed analysis and measure implementation and plot assembly separately from scientific interpretation.

already_counted.description: Scientific specification, actual dataset checks, retained implementation/repair, runs, interpretation and notebook writing

incremental.description: Maintain numerical reference cases and plotting metadata compatibility

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case is a novel calibration/model problem with no comparable code checks and incompatible diagnostic output metadata; implementation and output assembly remain manual and no change is adopted. In a compatible analysis, s3 removes 8.75 hours of implementation and s5 removes 10 hours of actual manual assembly, less 2 hours upkeep. Scientific decisions and existing numerical runtime remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Present findings and write scientific papers

steps.what: Select the actual research findings, verified figures, analysis provenance and real references for the conference presentation and journal paper.
inputs: Actual completed research results and genuine reference library
outputs: Actual selected scientific evidence and presentation argument

steps.what: Write the paper and conference material in {DOCS}, using the astronomer's actual argument and evidence; draft assistance is confined to supplied methods/results wording and does not invent references or claims.
inputs: Actual selected argument and source package from s1
outputs: Draft paper and conference material with source-linked claims

loop.purpose: Draft wording from a fixed actual scientific evidence package
loop.input: Actual author-selected argument, results, methods and permitted references from s1
loop.output: Draft methods/results prose with explicit source links and unknowns
loop.check: Author checks claims and references in s4, actual coauthors review in s5, and final dispatch version is checked in s6
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported claims, references or scientific framing return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native manuscript and slide templates are used first; expressing the supplied methods and findings in prose is not exact field mapping.

steps.what: Format the actual manuscript bibliography, figure references and conference layout using the existing native reference manager and publication template in {DOCS}.
outputs: Complete draft manuscript and presentation material

steps.what: Check and revise the completed paper and presentation claims, numerical values, actual references and scientific limitations against the actual research, including corrections required after coauthor comments.
inputs: Actual coauthor comments when returned from s5
outputs: Scientifically checked and corrected paper and presentation version

steps.what: Review the actual completed paper and conference material as research coauthors, checking scientific content, attribution and author agreement; return substantive changes for s2-s4 and review the corrected version.
outputs: Actual coauthor comments and agreement for a specified final version

steps.what: Check the actual final paper, presentation material, author agreement and journal destination after revisions, and authorise that completed manuscript version and destination for submission.
outputs: Final submission package and version/destination authorisation

steps.what: Save the final paper and presentation material in the same {DOCS} project folder.
outputs: Saved final scientific material

steps.what: Submit the actual final manuscript through the journal submission portal, only for the package and destination authorised in s6.
outputs: Actual submitted journal manuscript

steps.what: Present the actual research findings at the scientific conference, explaining uncertainties and answering the audience's scientific questions using the actual checked material.
outputs: Actual delivered scientific presentation and discussion

tasks.design: Use native publication formatting and bounded evidence-based wording assistance while preserving actual scientific argument, revisions, coauthor work and live presentation. OTHER is the existing journal submission portal. Coauthor review is real existing collaboration labour, not invented author self-approval. The author checks the completed final package before its separate actual submission; any changed manuscript or destination returns through the relevant checks and s6.
tasks.previous_blocker: Writing and repeated citation/layout work can consume time after the actual scientific result exists.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference/layout tools and bounded prose drafting can reduce assembly with actual source checking retained.
tasks.still_hard: A fluent paper can misstate a result or conceal an important limitation.
tasks.human_edge: Choose the scientific argument and defend it under questioning.

ambition.what: Present and publish the existing actual research findings.

tasks.altitude: Set a reproducible claim-to-evidence standard for scientific material.

evidence.claim: Reference-manager formatting and bounded prose drafting can assist manuscript preparation without replacing scientific review or live presentation.

assumptions: Conditional baseline has real coauthors and actual journal submission; shares are unmeasured active-work estimates.
Actual source research and reference records already exist; selection is counted in s1 and no new result is created by drafting.
All scientific correction, coauthor review and live conference delivery remain; no new minutes or post-talk record is added.
No public upload of conference slides is assumed beyond the separate actual journal submission.
unknowns: Actual author agreements, venue templates and permitted drafting use
research_questions: Compare a real manuscript revision using actual references, tracking wording repair separately from native formatting.

already_counted.description: Actual evidence selection, retained writing/repair, author checks, final package check, save, submission and live presentation
Actual coauthor scientific review and agreement

incremental.description: Maintain claim-source checks and venue formatting configuration

approvals.approved_version: Completed final manuscript and journal destination checked in s6 after coauthor agreement; changes require s6 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case has highly novel scientific framing and incompatible venue formatting, so actual writing, references and layout stay manual and no change is adopted. Eligible assembly removes 9 writing hours plus 10 formatting hours from 90 focal-role baseline hours, 21.11%; subtract 2 hours upkeep per 100 focal baseline hours. Ten coauthor hours remain separate and fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Choose the actual celestial phenomenon, target and observation strategy, considering the ground-based or space-borne instrument's constraints and actual scientific question.
inputs: Actual scientific question, target and instrument constraints
outputs: Actual observation strategy and required scientific settings

steps.what: Prepare the actual observation request or parameter file in the existing telescope observation tool; a compatible native template supplies repeated target identifiers and instrument-mode headers only.
inputs: Actual chosen strategy and settings from s1
outputs: Draft actual observation request with supplied scientific settings

steps.what: Select the actual calibration observations, exposure constraints and scientific checks needed for this celestial study, correcting the actual request accordingly.
outputs: Complete actual observation/calibration request

steps.what: Check the completed actual observation request, target, mode, calibration and current observability, authorising the specific final request for its actual instrument execution or submission route.
inputs: Actual current instrument and observation constraints
outputs: Version-specific and instrument-specific observation authorisation or hold

steps.what: Submit the actual final observation request to the telescope control or scheduling system, only for the request and instrument authorised in s4.
outputs: Actual submitted observation request

steps.what: Study the actual observations and instrument quality indications as the data become available, assessing the celestial phenomenon and deciding whether the scientific observations are usable.
inputs: Actual calibration and instrument quality indications
outputs: Actual scientific observation assessment and limitations

steps.what: Write the actual observation quality, instrument conditions and scientific notes in the existing observing notebook {DOCS}, after the observations have actually occurred.
inputs: Actual observed output and assessment from s6
outputs: Actual observing notes linked to the observation identifiers

steps.what: Save the actual observing notes in the same {DOCS} observing notebook.
outputs: Saved actual observing notes

tasks.design: Reuse a compatible native request template only for repeated identifiers and mode headers. OTHER means the actual telescope observation/scheduling software. Keep scientific choices, calibration planning, actual observation assessment and genuine observing notes. Existing telescope acquisition, archive generation and scheduler runtime are not new savings. Any changed target, setting or actual condition invalidates s4 before the separate real request submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: An observation request can repeat identifiers and mode headers despite requiring new scientific choices.
tasks.enabler_now: A compatible native request template can supply those repeated fields.
tasks.still_hard: Calibration, target variability and actual instrument quality determine whether an observation answers the question.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when technically acquired data do not support the intended study.

ambition.what: Carry out the existing actual celestial study.

tasks.altitude: Specify clear observation and calibration quality criteria.

evidence.claim: Native observation templates can reuse identifiers while scientific settings, calibration and output assessment remain human work.

assumptions: Conditional workflow already prepares a request and actual observing notes; no extra monitoring report is introduced.
Only 20% of request preparation is repeated target/mode metadata; all scientific parameters and correction remain.
Actual observing facilities and their existing technical operators continue unchanged; no supplier or observatory labour saving is claimed.
Shares estimate active astronomer work, not elapsed telescope exposure or scheduling wait.
unknowns: Actual instrument request format and template compatibility
research_questions: Inspect a real observation request and measure repeated identifiers separately from scientific setting choices.

already_counted.description: Actual scientific planning, retained request work, calibration decisions, final request check, submission, observation assessment and actual notes

incremental.description: Check target and instrument-template headers after instrument changes

approvals.approved_version: Completed actual request and instrument checked in s4; changed settings or conditions require s4 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case uses a one-off instrument mode or incompatible target metadata, so all request fields remain manual and no template change is deployed. Compatible repeated requests remove only 3 hours of target/mode metadata entry from s2, less 0.5 hour upkeep. Calibration, observation study, actual notes and the small submit action remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the other astronomers' actual research results, proposed methods and questions before the collaborative research discussion.
inputs: Actual collaborator research material and questions
outputs: Actual understood issues and scientific questions

steps.what: Collaborate with the other astronomers through actual scientific discussion, resolving method disagreements, dividing actual research work and interpreting the project's next questions together.
outputs: Actual shared scientific decisions and research responsibilities

steps.what: Select and prepare the actual existing research files for the agreed collaboration handoff in {DATA_PLATFORM}; a native manifest supplies only selected filenames, version identifiers and existing links.
inputs: Actual agreed scientific handoff from s2
Actual existing research files and their access restrictions
outputs: Complete actual selected research handoff package and manifest

steps.what: Check the actual completed research handoff package, file versions, permissions and named collaborator recipients, authorising that final package and recipient set for sharing.
inputs: Actual complete handoff package from s3
Actual agreed recipients and restrictions from s2-s3
outputs: Version-and-recipient-specific research handoff authorisation

steps.what: Share the actual selected research package with the named collaborators through {DATA_PLATFORM}, only under the final package and recipient authorisation from s4.
outputs: Actual research files shared with authorised collaborators

tasks.design: Preserve actual scientific collaboration and use a native manifest only for repeated file/version/link listing in an existing real file handoff. Do not add meeting minutes, a new project tracker or a trailing collaboration record. The selected existing research files are actual inputs produced by normal research; their scientific production is not automated by manifest generation. Changed package or recipient permissions return to s4 before the separate actual share.
tasks.previous_blocker: A research handoff can require manually listing selected file names and versions after scientific selection is complete.
tasks.enabler_now: A native manifest can list exact metadata for the actual selected files.
tasks.still_hard: Which files are scientifically appropriate and permitted to share still needs judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve scientific disagreements and agree work that the collaborators trust.

ambition.what: Carry out the existing collaborative research project.

tasks.altitude: Make the actual scientific and file-handoff responsibilities explicit.

evidence.claim: Native file manifests can supply exact filenames and versions but cannot choose scientific relevance or sharing permissions.

assumptions: Conditional collaboration already includes actual research-file sharing and manually listed file/version metadata; no new administrative baseline is added.
Only 10% of package preparation is literal repeated listing; selection, scientific explanation and permission work remain.
Collaborator research production and conversation continue unchanged; no other-role saving or unchecked sibling saving is claimed.
All shares are active-work estimates, not a measured project baseline.
unknowns: Whether an actual manually written file manifest exists and whether stored version metadata is reliable
research_questions: Inspect an actual collaborator handoff and identify manual metadata listing separately from scientific file selection.

already_counted.description: Actual research reading, collaboration, scientific package selection, permission checks and share

incremental.description: Verify version metadata and manifest configuration when the storage convention changes

approvals.approved_version: Actual final file package, versions and named recipients checked in s4; changes require s4 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case has no manually written manifest or unreliable version metadata; actual file selection and handoff stay unchanged and no new record is introduced. With a real compatible manual manifest, native metadata removes 2.5 hours of listing, less 0.5 hour upkeep. Scientific discussion, selection, final permission checks and actual sharing remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Specify reproducible scientific checks and evidence standards while keeping interpretation, observation choices and collaborative judgement.
role.ambitious_version: An astronomer who reduces proven code and assembly work and spends the retained time on scientific significance, instrument judgement and research discussion.
